All six are educational historical entries, not additions to the legally classified French wine-grape list. Article 81(2)(b) names Noah, Othello, Isabelle, Jacquez, Clinton and Herbemont as excluded from classification. Checked against EUR-Lex consolidated 18 August 2026 indexed text; the full English endpoint presented a JavaScript wall, while the same-date German text confirmed the names. Exclusion from classification is not described as a universal ban on possessing plants.

Othello #8838 and Othello Arnold #26119 are separately catalogued: do not import the latter’s marker pedigree without an identity check. Isabella/Isabelle is a single entry, id isabella. Petit Meslier is the canonical library form of VIVC Meslier Petit #7675.
